entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to add the informant as the O.P. No.2 during course of day.

4. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites must be filed on or before 05.01.2024, failing which the quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
5.

6. In the meantime, the order dated 09.11.2017 passed Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61087 of 2017(2) dt.18-12-2023 by the learned C.J.M., Jehanabad in Mahila (Jehanabad) P.S. Case No.39/2016, whereby cognizance of offence under sections 376 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken, shall remain stayed.

entities.text: Ujjwal Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R., it would manifest that the informant alleges that petitioner on pretext of marriage established physical relation.
It is next submitted that the allegations as alleged in the F.I.R. are cryptic and lacking in essential details.

It is also submitted that police after investigation did not find the case true under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code but the learned Magistrate differing with the police report took cognizance of the offences under sections 376 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
The learned counsel further submits that the stage of the case from the stage of cognizance till date has not changed.

8. It is made clear that in the event if the stage of the case from the stage of cognizance has changed,
in that event the present order shall not be given effect to.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) amit/-
